All figures decorated with rauponga and whakarare. Remainder of lid and box surface with rauponga spirals.

physical.summary: Small gourd container, ipu: internal lid held by suspension cord of two-ply twisted string; design of spirals and pitau pricked in and coloured black.

cultural.vision_reason: This is a carved wooden lid with Māori-style scroll/rauponga-like carved motifs, made for a box attributed to Māori production. Wrong claimed category (ceramic instead of woodwork/household), but the object itself fits Māori material culture.
